name: SCIB
recent: SCIB 近期完成一项土地收购（交易于 2026 年 10 月 19 日成为无条件），并提议设立最高 15% 的雇员股份计划（ESOS）。董事会也出现变动，主席 Datuk Chong Loong Men 于 2026 年 9 月 18 日辞职。
notable: 拟收购土地的所有先决条件已于 2026 年 10 月 19 日达成，协议成为无条件。
涉及最多 15% 已发行股份，其中 80% 分配给关键人员。
risks: 公司于 2026 年 9 月 17 日公告重大诉讼。
2025 财年净亏损 2,901 万令吉，净利率为 -161.3%，较上一期的 -5.1% 大幅恶化。
2025 财年营收为 1,798 万令吉，环比下降 61.1%。
earnings: 2025 财年营收为 1,798 万令吉，环比下降 61.1%；净亏损为 2,901 万令吉，净利率为 -161.3%，而上一期为 -5.1%。

events.what: 土地收购协议成为无条件

recent_en: SCIB recently completed a land acquisition (agreement became unconditional on 19 October 2026), proposed a change of external auditors, and proposed an ESOS of up to 15% of issued shares. There was also a boardroom change with chairman Datuk Chong Loong Men resigning on 18 September 2026.
notable_en: All conditions precedent for the proposed land acquisition were fulfilled on 19 October 2026, making the agreement unconditional.
Proposed appointment of Morison LC as new external auditor, replacing the current auditor.
Proposed establishment of an ESOS of up to 15% of issued shares, with 80% allocated to key personnel.
risks_en: The company announced material litigation on 17 September 2026.
FY2025 net loss was MYR 29.01 million with a net margin of -161.3%, significantly worse than the previous -5.1%.
FY2025 revenue was MYR 17.98 million, down 61.1% quarter-on-quarter.
earnings_en: FY2025 revenue was MYR 17.98 million, down 61.1% quarter-on-quarter; net loss was MYR 29.01 million with a net margin of -161.3%, compared to -5.1% in the previous period.
